title: Round 6 stream C: the gunship facing the sky near the boss hole not reproduced headless (instrumented as state().camSky); the streak callouts step aside, left and right
context: Owner, 2026-11-05, after round 5 (spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-round-6-five-notes-design.md, stream C): 3) controlling the gunship while Isao is close to the boss sinkhole makes the gunship face the sky; 4) the streak callouts should not sit centred on the tank but slightly offset, alternating left and right. Branch round-6-fixes off 9f0eab02, port 18183, unpushed.
outcome: NOTE 4, landed: a streak callout (co-streak, every fifth kill) takes a side class from src/domain/callout-side.js, co-streak-l then co-streak-r, offset with `left` at -9vw / +9vw (styles.css; co-pop owns transform, so not a transform), none in the praise-off layout whose column is already off-centre. A6 POSTED, which shared co-streak, has its own centred co-a6 (same blue, still kept by the praise switch); the dent and every other callout stay centred. showCallout's first two lines unchanged (test/voice-hooks.mjs). Measured on the page (step --streak-sides, 15 kills through damageEnemy): the three streak callouts' centres at -130, +130, -130 px of a 1440 px screen (-9 / +9 / -9 vw); on the base all three sat at 0. td-tab 5,357 -> 5,355 lines, bytes below the base. NOTE 3, NOT REPRODUCED: no fix, by the systematic-debugging rule (no fix before the cause is shown). What was measured: a renderer hook recording every painted frame of the main camera, forward . radial (the radial is the seat's `up`, the platform's normal, src/sentry-pilot.js pose()), with the seat / glide / map flags, on the arena route (?boss=1 at the door's sector + 1, the hull put down 2 hops from the arena's cell, arenaNow, THE MOTHER's card, TAKE THE GUN): 1,642 frames over 48 s, 1,539 seated; the glide into the seat (about 1.6 s here); the mouse dragged five times during the glide and every 2.5 s after it; the hull moved onto the hole's rim (3.6 cells from its centre) at 18 s and off (5-10 cells) at 33 s: forward . up stayed in [-0.994, -0.309] (the card's picture -0.31, the seat -0.94 / -0.99 as the mouse moved the pitch), 0 frames above the horizon, 0 above -0.2 while seated. Two more routes did not get there headless: the seat taken from the strip during the FEIDS-26 drop's ant view (the drop's clock reached 4.1 s before THE MOTHER's card paused it: the boss rose first) and the real drive (a simplified driver stuck 148 cells out in 200 s). Why the seat itself cannot face up: its pitch is held in [pitchMin -1.5621, pitchMax -0.95] by every writer (mount, aimShip, the pointer, showcase.aim; attach() is unclamped but only the harness's aimAt reaches it outside the mount), and direction = forward cos(p) + up sin(p) with |forward . up| <= 1 gives forward . up <= 0.58 - 0.81 < 0; the third view backs off along that same direction; shots end in pilot mode (td-tab endShot); the map (T) is the orbit view. The one seat path that can look up is the seat glide (src/fx/seat-glide.js), which slerps from the LAST PAINTED PICTURE: measured on the module, a 1.8 s glide leaving a picture 10 / 30 / 60 degrees above the horizon spends 0.55 / 0.75 / 0.87 s facing the sky, then lands on the seat; it holds still while the game is paused (frame() returns before the camera is placed). Up-looking pictures near the hole exist: the FEIDS-26 drop's ant view (src/domain/reinforcements.js dropCamera, 16.5-28 s of the drop, eye 0.2 m up looking at the laggard mech) and the hole door's rise (under the lip, looking up). Instrumented instead: src/fx/cam-jump.js's sample now also reads forward . radial every seated frame; state().camSky = { frames, up (frames over the horizon), top (the highest dot), first[8], last[8] (each with the seat, the glide, the shot, the boss phase and `hole`, the hull's distance in cells to the arena's centre) }, cleared with camJumpClear(); --arena-fight prints it and asserts none from TAKE THE GUN on (green: 0 of 1,638 seated frames through the whole fight, the 40 mm and the MK-9 fired, the highest -0.31). Question for the owner: the exact moment (which view: the seat's own, V's third, T's map; the seat taken from THE MOTHER's card, from the strip or with the key; during or right after the FEIDS-26 drop; for a moment as the seat opens, or held), so the next probe starts from that picture.
alternatives: Ship the design's defensive glide fix anyway (start every seat glide from a picture that already looks down, advance on wall time at dt 0, steer the goal instead of re-beginning): rejected for now, the glide was not shown to be the cause on the route; it is the ready fix if the owner names a moment that starts from an up-looking picture (the drop's ant view, the hole door's rise)
Offset the streak callouts with a transform: rejected, the co-pop keyframes own transform and would overwrite it
Decide the side inside showCallout with a third argument: rejected, test/voice-hooks.mjs pins its signature and first two lines; the side comes from the class name instead
evidence: node test/callout-side.mjs (two streak callouts alternate, others carry none, the wiring and the stylesheet's `left` rules)
node test/cam-jump.mjs (the sky meter: a look down is not the sky, 0.3 rad over the horizon counts with its sine, off-seat frames ignored, first/last eight, clear)
